_readme: Copy this file to configs/<your-slug>.json, fill it in, then add one line to configs/index.json.
That's the whole process for adding a league — no code changes.
sheetsApi is the Apps Script web app /exec url — one url instead of five CSVs.
Leave the 'sheets' CSV urls in as a fallback, or delete them once the API works.
trailer is optional — delete the whole block and nothing renders.
Add a 'submission' block to a game and it appears on the Submit page.
source: 'roster' (anyone you own) or 'acquisitions' (added in W1-4)
GAMES: every game needs id, name, color, payout, activeWeeks, decidedWeek.
'builder' wires the game to a standings table. Available builders:
longgame · tactician · sleeper · cardiac · comeback · topscore · comingsoon
Omit 'builder' for a game you score by hand — the page renders with rules only.
'color' is one of: green gold red blue purple orange teal
'payout' is a number (dollars). Totals are summed for you on the overview.
'activeWeeks' drives the calendar row. Include playoff weeks if the game runs that long.
'comingsoon' renders a teaser card instead of standings — use it for a game
you've announced but not finished designing. Reads 'teaser' and 'teaserFacts'.
'decidedWeek' is the week the winner is named — it gets a crown on the calendar.

games.name: The Long Game
games.blurb: One-line version, shown on the overview card.
games.desc: The full pitch. Shown on the game page behind a More toggle.
games.highlight: The one thing people need to remember, called out above the rules.
games.emptyHint: What to do when there's no data yet.
